data.raw_text:
‘WE ARE HOPEFUL THAT PEACE AND UNITY WILL CONTINUE’

Nagpasalamat ang National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) sa naging maayos na unang araw ng three-day peace rally ng Iglesia Ni Cristo (INC) sa Quirino Grandstand nitong Linggo, Nov. 16.

Tinatayang umabot sa 650,000 ang dumalo sa unang araw ng kilos-protesta, ayon sa Manila Public Information Office.

“Unity and discipline among members were key factors that led to a well-organized and peaceful activity today, November 16, 2025.  Further, our strengthened coordination and open communication paved the way to a comprehensive and flexible security coverage,” saad ng NCRPO.

“As we move forward to the next two days of the activity, the NCRPO stays committed to protecting the public and keeping the flow of events peaceful and organized,” dagdag pa nila.
